newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat settles steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat settles steady to higher.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled steady to higher on spillover support from CBOT and KCBT wheat and sentiment that the market had become technically oversold, traders said.

"This was a bounce from our Monday slump. The feeling was that there was nothing else to bring us down any further today, so we had to go higher," a MGE floor source said. "Volume was pretty good but not as good as yesterday."
MGE spring wheat settled steady to 3-1/4 cents per bushel higher, with July unchanged at $3.72. New crop September gained 3-1/4 cents to close at $3.61-1/2.
Linnco Futures was a featured seller, shedding 1.8 million Sept bushels and 900,000 July, traders said.
The MGE estimated Tuesday's spring wheat futures volume at 29.785 million bushels.
